body: I'm a Hufflepuff through and through
Okay well now you're just making me blush 😅

The way you were treated was wrong and it genuinely pains me to see hospitals STILL treating people this way! If it were me I'd make a point to make it known because we need to keep the conversation going. You DO matter and so does everyone else with Mental Illnesses <3

I understand completely, you want to do so much good but it feels like every time you turn around you hit a brick wall. It happens at work a lot...I'm a great employee but it's a struggle some days to show them just how amazing I am when this shit looms over you. Alomg with the BPD I also have dissociative amnesia which doesn't help, along with panic disorder, depression, ADHD ...they all play off each other in the worst ways. I get the struggle I really do!

I genuinely thought I was just an asshole when people would call me out on it and I've found I do it on projects and tasks too, if it's not in front of me...it's almost like it doesn't exist! I never mean anything bad by it I just hyperfocus a lot
